vm.scope: real LUKS/systemd/QEMU lifecycle with synthetic data; nested TCG is NOT an isolation guarantee
checks: PASS: manager detects a SIGKILL-interrupted receiver and deletes its private copy only after confirmation
PASS: manager opens a readonly networkless import VM without sharing a filesystem
PASS: cancelling the manifest destroys the source VM and leaves the active chat unchanged
PASS: confirmed files are verified, group-editable and visible only inside the session
PASS: reconciliation reads a private durable receipt without rehashing or deleting later chat edits
PASS: source VM death invalidates approval and closes the session through the manager
PASS: imported documents and later edits survive a fresh VM and LUKS reopening
PASS: receipt and confirmed cleanup survive LUKS reopening and the recovery menu can lock both volumes
PASS: an unresponsive recipient stays interlocked until explicit forced closure reaps both VMs
PASS: blocking from the approval screen revokes the copy before both LUKS volumes close
PASS: ephemeral import and edits disappear at closure with the persistent general byte-identical
PASS: manager output contains neither document payloads nor volume passwords
